dispositions.reason: Restored 피하다 as governing the sect’s anger and kept remaining honor as the stake to protect, not an object of avoidance.
Replaced ‘at least one of us’ with wrecking Taekyung himself, matching 나 하나.
Rendered 이 큰형님이 as eldest brother per glossary, not generic big brother.
Replaced the pride concession with a sneer at putting on martial-family airs, matching 주제에.
Kept Taekyung’s slangy clout understatement for 방귀 좀 뀐다 and named them a sect, not a family.
Rendered 텅 빈 as an unguarded opening after the deflection, not an unclothed chest.
Treated 개 같은 추임새 as ridiculous yelps, not a literal dog sound.
Restored 떨떠름한 얼굴 as the queasy look on the comic beat.
Changed 오십여 to about fifty, an approximate count rather than a floor above fifty.
Restored the first clash as a grinding scrape, distinct from the later cannon-like 쾅.
Rendered 군현(郡縣) as commanderies and counties, both administrative levels.
